response.original_title: [[FAQ's$ADD~Guideline]] How do I add a passenger to my Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: To add Passengers to an existing Silversea Cruise 1-888-512-8367(US) you must call Silversea Cruise customer service directly ✔ 1-888-512-8367(US) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done on. Additions are subject to Passenger capacity, lifeboat capacity, and ship availability, and ✔ 1-888-512-8367 (US) [US] will likely require re-pricing your Passenger at current, not original, rates. To add Passengers to an existing Silversea Cruise , you must contact Silversea Cruise directly at ✔ 1-888-512-8367(US) , or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done on. Additions are subject to capacity, require re-pricing at current rates, and ✔ 1-888-512-8367 (US) [US] require new Passenger details (name, DOB, passport). To add someone to an existing Silversea Cruise Passenger, you must call Silversea Cruise customer service directly at (1-888-512-8367 in the US / 1-888-512-8367(UK).
